newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower amid profit-taking on selected shares, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock exchange all-share price index dropped 5.9 points or 0.49 percent at 1,173.5 on a turnover of 66.1 milllion taka on Tuesday. Losers led gainers by 94 to 37.

"The market is mostly steady and I don't expect any significant change in market behavior before the new budget," said one broker. The country's budget for the fiscal year to end-June is due to be announced on June 12.
Bangladesh Lamps fell 11 taka to 5,126, Bata Shoe rose 11 to 138 and Reckitt & Colman lost 8.27 to 192.
